SR-001.evidence: tests/threat_model.rs::mitigated_without_evidence_is_caught; tests/threat_model.rs::nonexistent_evidence_is_caught; tests/threat_model.rs::valid_evidence_is_accepted; review of README.md and src/lib.rs recorded in quickstart.md scenario 8

SR-003.justification: Deleting R-22 yields baseline-missing R-22, a second R-10 row yields duplicate-id R-10, and an R-99 row yields baseline-unknown; each test asserts no other rule fires.

SR-009.justification: The policy names GitHub private vulnerability reporting with its URL, asks for no public issue, pull request or discussion, and links THREAT_MODEL.md for scope. Enabling the feature in repository settings is a maintainer action outside the code.
